anomalies.observed: On the Thermocouples sheet, U7 pin 6 CS and U7 pin 7 SO both carry the label NET0010; U1 pin 7 SO and U10 pin 7 SO are also NET0010. On the MCU sheet, NET0010 is attached to U4 pin 16 GPIO04, while the other thermocouple SPI nets are on U4 GPIO02/GPIO03/GPIO05 (NET0016/NET0014/NET0001).
anomalies.expected: The specification requires three independent chip-selects CS0-CS2 and a shared SCK/SO bus, with SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10 and CS pins GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7.

evidence.quote: Thermocouples sheet: U7 pin 6 CS NET0010 and pin 7 SO NET0010; U1 pin 7 SO NET0010; U10 pin 7 SO NET0010.
MCU sheet: U4 pin 16 GPIO04/ADC1_CH4 NET0010; pin 15 GPIO03 NET0014; pin 14 GPIO02 NET0016; pin 18 GPIO05 NET0001.
SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10, CS pins GPIO4/6/7 ... three independent chip-selects CS0–CS2

anomalies.impact: U7 chip-select is merged with the SPI MISO/SO net and MCU GPIO04. Selecting U7 will drive or load the shared SO line, corrupting thermocouple reads, and the SPI bus is not on the GPIOs expected by the firmware.

anomalies.observed: NET0009 appears only at D6 pin 2 WS2812B DIN. NET0008 and NET0011 appear on the fan-header/tach protection circuitry (J1 pin 2, J3 pin 3, R1/R9, D5/D11/D2), but no ESP32 pin on the MCU sheet carries NET0008, NET0009, or NET0011; the U4 GPIO06-GPIO10 pins are shown without those labels.
anomalies.expected: The design is intended to monitor two fan tachometers and drive a WS2812B status LED, so these signals must connect to MCU GPIOs.

evidence.quote: MCU sheet: D6 WS2812B pin 2 DIN NET0009; U4 GPIO06-GPIO10 pins have no NET0009/NET0008/NET0011 labels.
Power sheet: J1 pin 2 NET0008 and J3 pin 3 NET0011.
Monitors 2 fan tachometers ... and a single onboard WS2812B status LED (D1).

anomalies.impact: Fan tach inputs and the WS2812 status LED would not be controlled or read by the ESP32, disabling fan-stall detection and status indication.

anomalies.observed: D3 LED and its series resistor R7 are connected to NET0007, which is ESP32 GPIO1 and U9 pin 2 IN/DIAG_EN. The heater output from U9 pin 7 to J10 pin 2 has no LED or series resistor.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the status LED and series resistor are on the heater output net, so the LED indicates the actual heater output rather than only the MCU control signal.

evidence.quote: MCU sheet: D3 LED and R7 500 are tied to NET0007; U9 pin 2 DIAG_EN/IN is also NET0007, while U9 pin 7 OUT goes to J10 pin 2.
A status LED (D2) and series resistor (R3) are also on the HEATER net

anomalies.impact: The onboard heater indicator would light when GPIO1 is asserted even if the high-side switch output is open, shorted, faulted, or otherwise not energizing the heater.
